name: model-router
description: Sends simple, tool-free turns to a cheaper model to save usage; everything else stays on your model.

cheapModel.title: Cheaper model
cheapModel.description: The model simple turns are sent to.

maxMessages.title: Longest conversation to route
maxMessages.description: Past this many messages a switch would re-send the whole conversation uncached to the other model, which can cost more than it saves, so turns stay on your model.
